The '''Sensile Blossom''' was a rare type of small blossoming plant native to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. It had green leaves and bright red blossoms. These plants could be found around the planets capital of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Onderonian Botanist" />
